coin.title: Malta 10 euro 2024 ‘Karnival ta’ Malta’ Silver Prooflike PL69
coin.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WQMOBX4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Your new Malta 10 euro 2024 ‘Karnival ta’ Malta’ Silver Prooflike PL69 is waiting for you. PL69 coins dazzle with rich shine and nearly flawless surfaces. Minor marks are virtually invisible, preserving their brilliance. This coin is a wonderful choice for collectors seeking high visual impact. Design The Malta 10 Euro 2024 ‘Karnival ta’ Malta’ Silver Prooflike is a special issue with a colored detail. On the obverse of the coin, an animated figure looks up, arms spread out. On the head is a mask, that is a referral to the use of masks during the Malta Carnival. The background consists of a Mandala-pattern: this is specially colored in rainbow colors, which makes the coin even more unique. On the bottom of the coin is the text ’10 Euro Karnival ta’ Malta’. On the reverse is the logo of the Central Bank of Malta.
